title: 第十三章 青丘帝姬白筱如第十四章 撸猫
slug: 震惊我的徒弟居然是女帝
content_zh:
两界山。
一个身穿儒袍的圣境一重强者，正在追击一只雪白可爱的小狐狸。
奔跑中的小狐狸有些绝望，也有些不甘。
她本是青丘帝姬白筱如，狐族未来的狐帝。
修为更是达到了帝境一重，可以说是尊贵无比。
后来中州的未央大秘境开启。
各方势力的大佬云集，帝境都有十几位。
其中就有大梁帝国和赤天帝国的大帝。
在秘境中她遇到了两国的大帝。
两国大帝看到她的面容后，一下就陷了进去不可自拔。
此后两人不断的送礼献殷勤，更是为了她大大出手。
从开始的小打小闹，到最后的国战。
直到最后，两国的帝境强者陨落之后，他们才醒悟过来。
但此时为时已晚，他们国家强者陨落太多了，所以被其他国家攻破。
落得国破人亡。
后来就传出消息，是她蛊惑了两国的大帝。
说她红颜祸水，祸国殃民，会给中州带来无尽的战争。
随后就有帝国牵头，带领着其他帝国强者联手追杀她，防止灾难再次发生。
事情发展到后面，青丘也保不住她。
所以她只能逃命。

她本是九尾妖狐，但是现在只剩下一尾了。
每次遇到不可敌的危险时，她就献祭一尾。
来换取速度的暴增逃过追杀。
她一路从中州逃到了东洲，没想到那些势力还是穷追不舍。
现在她被一个搜寻的圣境发现。
之前献祭换来的力量也快用完了。
只剩下一尾的她，在献祭就等于自杀。
终于她的力量用完了，速度瞬间降了下来。
三息后，她就被圣境强者追上。
哈哈哈哈！
“你的力量用完了吧！”
“把你抓回去，陛下一定会给我丰厚的奖赏的。”
想到这里，圣境强者不免激动了起来。
看着敌人一步步靠近，白筱如眼中闪过一丝决绝。
她宁愿死也不想落到那个人的手里。
大梁和赤天两国的灭亡，虽然是和自己有关。
但如果没有那个人的挑拨，也不会走到这一步。
想到这里，她一下扑了上去，圣境强者随手一挥。
白筱如直接被打飞，撞到后面的树干上缓缓掉落。
受到这一击后，本来就有伤的白筱如，更加坚持不住了。

眼睛忽闪忽闪的，似乎快要闭上了。
content_en:
Two Boundary Mountains.
A strong man of the first level of the Holy Realm wearing a Confucian robe was chasing a snow-white and cute little fox.
The running little fox was a little desperate and unwilling.
She was originally Qingqiu Emperor Ji Bai Xiaoru, the future fox emperor of the fox clan.
His cultivation has reached the first level of the Emperor Realm, which can be said to be extremely noble.
Later, the Weiyang Great Secret Realm in Zhongzhou was opened.
Big bosses from all forces gathered, including more than a dozen in the Imperial Realm.
Among them were the emperors of the Daliang Empire and the Chitian Empire.
In the secret realm, she met the emperors of the two countries.
After the emperors of the two countries saw her face, they fell into it and couldn't extricate themselves.
From then on, the two of them continued to send gifts and show their attentiveness, and even made great moves for her.
From a small fight in the beginning to a national war in the end.
It was not until the end of the two countries that the powerful emperors in the two countries fell, did they wake up.
But it was too late at this time. Too many strong men in their country had fallen, so they were conquered by other countries.
The country was destroyed and people perished.
Later, news came out that she had bewitched the emperors of the two countries.
It is said that her beauty is a disaster, a disaster for the country and the people, and will bring endless war to Zhongzhou.
Then the empire took the lead and led other powerful empires to join forces to hunt her down and prevent the disaster from happening again.
When things developed later, Qingqiu couldn't save her.
So she could only run for her life.
She was originally a nine-tailed demon fox, but now she only has one tail left.
Every time she encountered invincible danger, she would sacrifice one tail.
In exchange for a sudden increase in speed, he could escape pursuit.
She fled all the way from Zhongzhou to Dongzhou, but she didn't expect that those forces were still pursuing her.
Now she is discovered by a searching Holy Land.
The power obtained from previous sacrifices is almost used up.
With only one tail left, sacrificing her would be tantamount to committing suicide.
Finally, her power ran out, and her speed dropped instantly.
After three breaths, she was caught up by a strong man from the Holy Realm.
Ha ha ha ha!
"Your power has run out!"
"If I take you back, Your Majesty will definitely give me a generous reward."
Thinking of this, the Saint Realm expert couldn't help but get excited.
Seeing the enemy approaching step by step, a trace of determination flashed in Bai Xiaoru's eyes.
She would rather die than fall into that man's hands.
Although the demise of Daliang and Chitian was related to himself.
But without that person's instigation, we wouldn't have reached this point.
Thinking of this, she pounced forward, and the Saint Realm powerhouse waved her hand.
Bai Xiaoru was knocked away directly, hit the tree trunk behind and slowly fell down.
After receiving this blow, Bai Xiaoru, who was already injured, could no longer hold on.
His eyes flickered and seemed to be about to close.
